argv:
pattern='(a(b)?)+'
subject='aba'
[[ "$subject" =~ $pattern ]]
match_status=$?
rematch_count=${#BASH_REMATCH[@]}
builtin printf 'EREOBS1\000N01\000%s\000%s\000' "$match_status" "$rematch_count"
if (( rematch_count > 4 )); then
  builtin printf 'CARDINALITY_OVERFLOW\000'
  exit 125
fi
for slot in 0 1 2 3; do
  if [[ ${BASH_REMATCH[$slot]+present} == present ]]; then
    builtin printf '%s\0001\000%s\000' "$slot" "${BASH_REMATCH[$slot]}"
  else
    builtin printf '%s\0000\000\000' "$slot"
  fi
done
exit "$match_status"
